_note: Every line in the game (M8; DESIGN.md 'Dialogue system'): family talk, radio calls, creatures and cutscene captions. Fields: id; speaker (config.story.speakers); channel 'radio' (a call while Tom's out), 'face' (said in the room; heard as a radio call when Tom's away) or 'caption'; text ({name} fills in from the caller); when { night: [min, max], phase: [...], all: [flags], none: [flags] }; priority (higher first); on (an event that plays it); next (the line that follows it); repeatable (never marked heard; dropped, not queued, if the radio's busy); kind (the radio's rate-limit kind); urgent (cuts the radio's queue, with the alarm pips); script (plays from its trigger only while that script is live: config.story.liveScripts); cue (where the line will be triggered, for the session that wires it). New lines are written with each encounter, with Aaron (Session 11).

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom. Wake up. Something's happened at the facility. Every channel's static except the emergency band.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: I need eyes on the woods. Get up the tower and tell me what you see.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, there's a car down at the campground. Those campers checked in two days ago. They never checked out.

lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Their fire's out. I saw the smoke over the trees last night, from my window. It's gone now.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: If they had any guns, we need them. Check the car and the tents.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Play it, Tom. Whatever they saw, I need to know.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: That wasn't an animal. I've heard things like that before, on the recordings. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, behind you! In the trees!

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: They didn't stop when you hit them. They just kept coming until they couldn't.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: The dead aren't supposed to get up, Tom. Pull the battery from their car and come home.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: East fence is torn up. The ledger's on the desk in the comms room. Patch it with the scrap you found.

lines.cue: Fence repaired (talk to Wyatt on Day 1)
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: That battery goes in the fence box by the gate. It'll put charge back in the wire.

lines.cue: Battery fitted; marker appears (talk to Junie on Day 1)
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Are they going to come here?

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Not if we're ready for them.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: This is how we stay alive. Left side is what we've got: fence, doors, charge. Right side is what's coming. Keep the left side bigger.

lines.cue: Night 1, first zombies at the fence
lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Movement on the east fence. Only a few. The wire's holding.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Tom, camera six. Look at this.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: She's burying something. The transmissions talked about marks like that, wherever the dead started rising.

lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: The ground's still glowing where she was. Like it's warm.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: It's on your map. You could dig it up now, or wait for light. Your call, Dad.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: We made it through. Whatever she buried is still out there. If we dig it up, maybe they stop coming.

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: You got it. The night went quiet after you dug it up. That has to mean something.

lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: She was singing. On the camera. Did you hear it?

lines.text: Is it over? Dad, is it really over?

lines.speaker: ellen
lines.text: Whatever was coming through... it's quiet now. It's quiet.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: We held it. All of us.

lines.text: Tom? Tom, can you hear me?

lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Dad, please answer.

lines.speaker: wyatt
lines.text: Dad, come in. Come in!

lines._note: Aaron (Session 9, #130): both charges on the hut.
lines.speaker: junie
lines.text: Dad? Are you sure you're ready? Once that hut goes she's got nowhere left to run. You'll have to finish her.
